collections/views#

Lazy views transform cursor traversal without changing their origins.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let visible = Taken(
    origin: Filtered(origin: users, condition: (user is User) is bool { user.active(); }),
    count: 10,
);

Description#

Lazy views transform cursor traversal without changing their origins. Views may be freely composed; no intermediate collection is materialized except the @T value intentionally emitted by Chunked.

Mapped, Filtered, Taken, Dropped and their while variants are lazy. Flattened removes exactly one Iterating layer. Pairwise emits adjacent pairs. Accumulated emits its explicit initial value before consuming the origin. Reduced projects the final accumulated value.

A typed action makes both sides of Mapped explicit:

let label is (User) is string = (user is User) is string { user.name(); };
let names = Mapped(origin: users, mapping: label);

Chunked materializes one bounded array at a time, including a shorter final array. Flattened can later join an Iterating of chunks or pages by one level:

let batches = Chunked(origin: rows, size: 100);
let rows_again = Flattened(origin: batches);

Accumulated is a running fold and includes the initial value. Reduced gives only the final fold result:

let totals = Accumulated(
    origin: prices,
    initial: 0,
    action: (total is int, price is int) is int { total + price; },
);
let total is int = Reduced(
    origin: prices,
    initial: 0,
    action: (sum is int, price is int) is int { sum + price; },
).total();

Sliced follows itertools.islice semantics: start and stop are non-negative, stop is exclusive, and step is positive. Reverse traversal belongs to Reversed and therefore requires a Sequencing origin:

let sample = Sliced(origin: events, start: 10, stop: 100, step: 5);
let newest_first = Reversed(origin: stored_events);
